title: Finite surjections with open local lifts dominate fppf coverings
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universes [def-weil-size-convention], quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $\{f_i:X_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a small fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site], meaning that the $f_i$ are flat, locally of finite presentation and jointly surjective. Then there exist a surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] finite morphism $p:X'\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and a small open covering $X'=\bigcup_{\alpha\in A}U'_\alpha$ [def-weil-open-immersion], such that for each $\alpha$ there are an index $i(\alpha)\in I$ and an $X$-morphism $U'_\alpha\to X_{i(\alpha)}$. No flatness of $p$ is asserted. The empty scheme and its empty covering are allowed.
